candidates.change_summary: Change the required incoming value from 10 ether to 9 ether, altering when the fallback accepts and thus when pastBlockTime and potential transfer change.
Remove the time ordering check so fallback no longer requires block.timestamp > pastBlockTime, changing when pastBlockTime gets updated and possible transfers occur.
Update pastBlockTime after the conditional transfer instead of before, so transfer decision uses the old pastBlockTime and the stored time differs after completion.
Change the transfer condition to trigger on block.number % 15 != 0, altering when balance is sent and thus observable state after fallback.
Replace the transfer call with sending only half the contract balance, changing post-call balances and thus observable behavior.
